title: 125 Duke (Adventure Spec)
description: The KTM 125 Duke (Adventure Spec) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 125cc engine generating 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
